issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies numberOfInscribedStudents as an int, but the solution implementation declares numberOfInscribedStudents as a long. This inconsistency leads to a type mismatch when computing getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the solution sums a long and an int but declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return int, which will not compile without an explicit cast. Students will be confused about the intended type and may encounter compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent. Either change numberOfInscribedStudents in the solution to int to match the UML and ensure all methods use int, or update the UML and related method signatures to use long for totals (e.g., have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return long and adjust other methods accordingly). Ensure the arithmetic and return types are consistent so the code compiles.
